name: Belrise Industries Ltd
title: Belrise Industries Ltd - 544405 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 manufacturing revenue up 21% and FY26 EBITDA margin 12.1%, but no supply-side evidence: capex guided up to 6-6.5% of manufacturing revenue and a INR2,000 crore QIP enabling resolution with acquisitions continuing.

capex.quote: We expect capex to remain in the range of 6% to 6.5% of our manufacturing revenue, reflecting ongoing investments in capacity and capability.

triggers.label: Aerospace acquisitions: SDM and Chester Hall
triggers.quote: in Q4, we followed that up with the acquisition of Chester Hall in UK

triggers.label: Mid-teens revenue growth and stable margins held
triggers.quote: We expect EBITDA margins to remain broadly stable as compared to our FY26 levels.

triggers.label: Q4 manufacturing revenue +21% YoY
triggers.quote: including manufacturing revenue of INR21,763 million, which grew 21% year-on-year

guidance.quote: We expect to continue delivering mid-teens revenue growth, consistent with our track record and momentum in our order book.
We expect EBITDA margins to remain broadly stable as compared to our FY26 levels.
We expect capex to remain in the range of 6% to 6.5% of our manufacturing revenue

prior_guidance_check.quote: We remain focused on sustaining this momentum
Both on the top line and at the margin level, we performed in line with our guidance.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Double four-wheeler and CV business over two years

red_flags.label: Repeated evasion on plant utilisation and break-even
red_flags.quote: We are unable to comment on plant-specific questions on utilization and break-even.

red_flags.label: Trading business margin dilutive; hiving off not ruled out
red_flags.quote: because again it's on a consolidated basis it is margin dilutive

red_flags.label: Q4 one-time loss at aerospace subsidiary
red_flags.quote: one-time operational loss of INR94.7 million in Q4 FY26 in our subsidiary

red_flags.label: Pass-through of transport costs unresolved
red_flags.quote: on the transportation costs, we're still in discussions with a couple of our key OEMs

evasions.topic: Plant utilisation and break-even timeline for new plants
evasions.quote: We are unable to comment on plant-specific questions on utilization and break-even.

evasions.topic: Suspension and polymer revenue, H-One revenue and PAT
evasions.quote: We do not have those figures handy at the moment, we're happy to, you know, let you know that offline.
Exact specifics about how much it would rise, I do not have with me at the moment
